task: Isolate the embedded OpenCode engine's global config location (XDG_CONFIG_HOME) from the user's global OpenCode config for codemie-code / codemie --task runs, mirroring the existing XDG_DATA_HOME isolation (EPMCDME-16963, single repo codemie-code).

key_reasoning.reason: Closest pattern is the XDG_DATA_HOME isolation in the codemie-code beforeRun hook (getOpenCodeStorageBase under CODEMIE_HOME). It covers the mechanism but not the behavioural unknowns: the embedded engine's config loading and first-run self-install of @opencode-ai/plugin in an empty config dir are unverified, the early-return branch before the XDG assignment leaves runs exposed, and Object.assign(process.env, env) in BaseAgentAdapter would leak the isolated value into the wrapper process (AC6). The ACs enumerate edge cases (missing/unreadable config, no global config, plain opencode agent unchanged), and no existing test template covers env-isolation assertions for beforeRun, so Technical Risk is bumped to L. No example in the calibration folders was available to cross-check.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped to L: the closest existing pattern (XDG_DATA_HOME isolation) does not cover the config-specific unknowns, and AC edge cases have no existing defensive test template
Clarity: open questions Q1-Q4 (loss of user global config, first-run install, early-return branch, unverified repro) keep Requirements Clarity at M
